subject: POC: MAP sprint — org bootstrap, ephemeral API keys, and peering window
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@heliohealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff: MAP & onramp — API keys, org setup, allowlist & peering

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the run through on Friday. HelioHealth is ready to start a 4-week POC focused on inference latency for our triage pipeline. The items we care about in the MAP are:
- Org and environment bootstrap (staging org, SSO config if needed)
- Ephemeral API keys for dev + staging (scoped to tenant)
- IP allowlist for our ingestion endpoints + VPC peering for low-latency traffic
- Acceptance criteria: successful run of the 10k-record synthetic workload with <120ms median token latency and stable throughput for 5m requests

Can you confirm Redwood's owners for each line item and an initial schedule? Also attaching our technical contacts file (HelioHealth-technical-contacts.csv).

We plan to provide an AWS account for peering — I'll loop in Jules from DevOps for specifics. Proposed kickoff window: Dec 8–12.

Thanks,
Samir
Director, ML Engineering
HelioHealth

Attachment: HelioHealth-technical-contacts.csv (csv)

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@heliohealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: MAP & onramp — API keys, org setup, allowlist & peering

Samir — thanks for the clear kickoff list. Confirming Redwood owners and an initial MAP sprint:

Redwood owners:
- Org bootstrap & SSO template: Neha (me) — will send org invite and staging naming convention
- Ephemeral API keys & scopes: Ben Carter — will share key TTL and scoping options
- Network allowlist & peering ops: Marissa Cole — will own the peering template + onboarding checklist

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (Dec 8): org bootstrap, whiteboard SSO and scope, exchange accounts
- Week 1 (Dec 9–15): create staging org, issue first ephemeral keys, allowlist initial IPs
- Week 2 (Dec 16–22): VPC peering handshake and test traffic
- Week 3 (Dec 23–29): run synthetic workload & iterate on performance tune

Action items for HelioHealth before kickoff: provide AWS account ID(s), VPC CIDR(s), and a primary technical contact for peering (Jules?).

I attached our Redwood MAP template (redwood-map-template.xlsx) so we can lock down owners/dates in a single place. Also, for peering — do you expect cross-account routing or a transit setup? If cross-account peering, we need the account ID and allowed CIDRs by Dec 8 to keep the Week 1 schedule.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-map-template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Jules Kim <jules.kim@heliohealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@heliohealth.com>, devops@heliohealth.com
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 14:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: MAP & onramp — API keys, org setup, allowlist & peering

Neha / team — looping in actual network details from DevOps. Quick answers below:
- AWS Account ID (peering target): 123456789012
- Primary VPC CIDR: 10.20.0.0/16 (staging)
- Public egress IPs to allowlist for callbacks: 34.82.21.44, 34.82.21.45
- We prefer a cross-account VPC peering (no transit) — low ops overhead for us.

Regarding keys: ephemeral keys are fine. Ideally TTL = 24 hours for dev keys, 72 hours for staging keys. Keys must be scoped to the tenant ID and read/write limited to the POC org.

Attaching our internal firewall request (helio-firewall-request.pdf) — it lists the subnets and NAT gateways. Let us know if the peering template needs any additional info.

On the acceptance criteria, we'll aim to provide a representative 10k dataset and a staging job to run during the Week 3 window.

Thanks,
Jules Kim
Cloud Infrastructure Lead, HelioHealth

Attachment: helio-firewall-request.pdf (pdf)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2025 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: POC key & infra plan for HelioHealth

Neha / Marissa — following Jules' details, here's what I'll provision and what I need: 

Provisioning plan (Redwood):
- Ephemeral API keys: will issue two staging-scoped keys (TTL 72h) and a dev pool (TTL 24h). Keys will be tenant-scoped and restricted to the POC org.
- Key rotation: automatic rotation script scheduled every 72h for staging keys; dev keys rotate on issuance.
- Access controls: limit token scopes to "inference:invoke" and "org:read" for POC tokens.

Needs from HelioHealth:
- Confirm account ID (123456789012) and target VPC CIDR (10.20.0.0/16) are final and non-overlapping with Redwood overlay (we currently use 10.20.128.0/18 in our peering pool — please confirm no overlap).
- Acceptance of SSH for peering test (temporary) or provide a bastion IP for the initial handshake.

I attached our standard vpc-peering-template.txt for Marissa to push to network team. If there is overlap in the CIDR, we should fall back to a NAT-forwarding path (adds latency) — call this out before Dec 12.

-ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: vpc-peering-template.txt (txt)

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@heliohealth.com>, Jules Kim <jules.kim@heliohealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2025 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: MAP & onramp — API keys, org setup, allowlist & peering (confirmed)

Samir / Jules — thanks for the quick turn. Recap and agreed MAP milestones so we can close the sprint plan: 

Agreed owners & deliverables:
- Neha (Redwood): finalize MAP spreadsheet and send calendar invites for Dec 09 (kickoff) and Dec 16 (peering test).
- Ben (Redwood): provision ephemeral keys (dev: TTL 24h; staging: TTL 72h) and deliver key scoping doc by Dec 11.
- Marissa (Redwood): file peering request with our infra team using vpc-peering-template.txt; target peering window Dec 16–18.
- Jules / HelioHealth: confirm no CIDR overlap with Redwood overlay (Ben flagged 10.20.128.0/18). If overlap exists, notify by EOD Dec 12 to allow fallback plan.

Close timeline and acceptance:
- Dec 09: MAP kickoff (calendar invite sent)
- Dec 11: Redwood provides first ephemeral keys + key scoping doc
- Dec 16–18: VPC peering handshake and basic network tests
- Week of Dec 22: synthetic workload run and latency verification

Next steps for you (HelioHealth): confirm the CIDR non-overlap and provide a bastion IP or SSH window for the peering handshake. Also confirm who will be the primary SSO admin so we can set up the staging org membership.

I'll upload the completed MAP after Dec 9; if everything stays on schedule we can aim to sign the POC acceptance at the end of the Week of Dec 22. Let me know if you want to tighten the schedule.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
